rules.name: Business cash valuation
rules.origin: Auditor operationalization of cited investor evidence; checklist and scenarios are not quotations or claimed historical procedures.
operational_steps: Reconcile earnings to cash available after maintenance spending and working capital. Separate expansion investment.
Write bear/base/bull cash paths, competitive assumptions and discount-rate sensitivity; report a range.
Reject precision unsupported by accounting or business knowledge.
rules.fits: Durable cash businesses with estimable reinvestment
rules.does_not_fit: Mechanical low P/E, EBITDA-only or book-value screens
rules.hard_numeric_threshold: Not established unless a cited claim explicitly supplies one.

statement_position_crosschecks.assessment: Small initial institutional stake and later Buffett general-account scaling coexist. Position size alone cannot identify the first human buyer.
Neither a blanket technology ban nor an all-asset-light mandate represents these documented eras.
Reluctance to sell controlled operating businesses does not promise never to sell marketable securities.
Berkshire is not a synonymous live Buffett personal portfolio after the CEO transition.

PCC full subsequent intrinsic value and realized disposal P&L are not established.
No claim of exhaustive lifetime mistakes, all holdings or current personal intentions.

roles.role: Chairman and CEO; principal capital allocator, alongside other authorized investment managers

identity.mandate: Permanent-capital operating conglomerate, insurance liabilities and float, public equities and wholly owned businesses. Not a retail portfolio or a redeemable long-only mutual fund.
identity.attribution_boundary: Buffett’s original statements can support his reasoning. Berkshire consolidated holdings include other decision makers, entities and scopes. Initial Apple deputy identity is not established here as Ted versus Todd.

fit_and_no_fit.fit: Auditor interpretation: understandable durable business cash generation; consumer franchises, insurance or other economics within demonstrated competence; controlled businesses require managerial and reinvestment assessment.
fit_and_no_fit.no_fit: No blanket technology or asset-heavy exclusion. Exclude valuation where maintenance investment, competition, financing needs or knowledge gaps prevent a defensible range. Berkshire-scale opportunities and insurance liquidity cannot simply be copied into a smaller personal account.
